hero.body: A smart teacher helps your child memorize the Quran in the voice of a skilled reciter, learn the Prophet's Sunnah and live it through good deeds, and get answers to their questions in words that fit their age, while you follow every step from your dashboard.

phone.hadithHint: Learn the meaning, then live it at home

how.title: How Gharsah works
how.subtitle: A smart teacher who teaches your child the Quran and Hadith, and answers their questions about their faith

quran.label: Quran
quran.title: Memorize the Quran with a smart teacher
quran.body: Your child hears each ayah from a skilled reciter, then repeats it aloud, while the teacher encourages and counts along until they master it.
quran.teacher: Today: Surah Al-Ikhlas… repeat it with me, ayah by ayah

hadith.label: Hadith
hadith.title: Understand the Hadith and live it
hadith.body: Your child learns a short hadith and its meaning in simple words, then turns it into a real deed at home.
hadith.teacher: Today's hadith is about kindness to parents 💛
hadith.child: I'll help her tidy the house

questions.label: Children's questions
questions.title: Answers their questions about Islam
questions.body: Your child asks out loud about whatever puzzles them, and the teacher answers in words that suit their age, using answers reviewed by specialists.
questions.teacher: Great question! Let's understand it together…
questions.child: Why do we pray five times a day?

parents.title: Follow their progress… without hovering over them
parents.body: A calm dashboard that shows what your child has memorized, what they've learned from the Hadith and the projects they've put into practice, and lets you hear their recordings in their own voice.

features.title: A report for every lesson
features.text: What they memorized, how long, and the teacher's note

features.title: Project recordings
features.text: Sent only to you, in your child's voice

features.title: More than one child
features.text: Up to {n} children on one account

sources.title: What your child learns
sources.subtitle: Every answer comes from a stated, trusted source — no guesswork, no generation.

quran.title: Learn the Quran
quran.body: Memorize the ayat in the voice of a skilled reciter; any question about an ayah is answered with sound, authoritative tafsir.
examples: What does "Allah, the Eternal Refuge" mean?
quran.source: Sources: Tanzil Quran · Al-Tafsir Al-Muyassar (King Fahd Complex) · Alafasy recitation

hadith.title: Learn the Hadith
hadith.body: Learn a hadith and its meaning in simple words, and how to live it every day through a real deed.
examples: How can I live the hadith on kindness to parents today?
hadith.source: Sources: Dorar Al-Saniyya · Encyclopedia of Translated Hadiths

islam.title: What is Islam?
islam.body: Any question about Islam that comes to anyone's mind, Muslim or not, gets a clear answer in words that suit their age.
islam.source: Sources: Quran & Sunnah · A'lam Al-Sunnah Al-Manshurah · Minhaj Al-Muslim

sources.banner: AI never composes any ayah or hadith — its role is to explain, encourage, and answer from trusted sources.
